notes.title: Get Back! Switch Game (also: Whistle Switch, Turnover Switch 2v2, Offense to Defense)
notes.objective: A 2v2 or 3v3 game where the coach’s whistle flips possession — kids learn to sprint back on defense the moment they lose the ball.
setup: Full court (or two half courts back to back with low baskets)
Two teams of 2–3; coach on the sideline with a spare ball
rules: Team A starts on offense attacking one basket.
Play normally; on a score, a steal, or the coach’s whistle, the other team immediately attacks the other basket.
On the whistle, the coach passes a new ball to the team that was on defense.
Point for scoring; bonus point for a team that has every player back past half court before the ball crosses.
variations: Easier: 2v1 waves — one defender always sprints back to stop two attackers.
Harder: whistle at random, even mid-shot.
Harder: 3v3 with a 3-pass rule before shooting.
coaching: Lose the ball? Sprint back — don’t stop to be sad!
Find the ball first, then your player.
Run to the basket, then turn and look.
